unified_features.name: Product catalog
unified_features.rationale: Only PyShop has a catalog; nothing to merge.
unified_features.behaviour: Anyone can list products (id, name, price) at GET /api/products.

unified_features.name: Shopping cart
unified_features.rationale: PyShop and NodeCart both add items to a cart; auto-pick kept NodeCart's best-evidenced version (M04) and dropped PyShop's (M03), taking PyShop's integer quantity typing into the improvement.
unified_features.behaviour: A signed-in customer adds a catalog product with a quantity to their own cart; adding the same product again increases the quantity.
unified_features.improvements: Quantity is a validated positive integer (not text); the cart comes from the session user, never from a client cartId; product_id must reference an existing Product.

unified_features.name: Stripe checkout
unified_features.behaviour: The customer checks out their cart; the server creates a pending Order and a Stripe Checkout session from cart lines and catalog prices; a verified Stripe webhook marks the Order paid.
unified_features.improvements: Line items and prices are built on the server, never taken from the request; Order record added; payment confirmed only by a signature-verified webhook; Stripe test mode.

unified_features.name: Product reviews
unified_features.rationale: Only Reviewly has reviews; rebuilt from its public docs.
unified_features.behaviour: Anyone can list the visible reviews of a product at GET /api/products/{id}/reviews.

unified_features.name: Write a review
unified_features.rationale: Only Reviewly has it; rebuilt from its public docs and spec.
unified_features.behaviour: A signed-in customer posts a rating (integer 1-5, checked on the server) and a comment for a product.

unified_features.name: Verified-purchase gate
unified_features.rationale: Only Reviewly has it; it needs the unified Order from U03.
unified_features.behaviour: A review is accepted only when the author has a paid Order containing that product; otherwise the API answers 403.
unified_features.improvements: Reviewly's exact rule (refuse or hide) is undocumented; the unified app refuses, which is simpler and testable.
